correctness.rationale: The actual simplicial triangle-edge boundary B and tetrahedron-triangle boundary D satisfy B^T B+DD^T=nI by edge/tetrahedron incidence cancellation. Thus every zonotope endpoint p_sigma=B sigma/2 has 4||p||^2=n C(n,3)-||D^T sigma||^2. Vanishing tetrahedron coboundary enforces transitive tournament labels on n-1 nonzero vertices, precisely (n-1)! oriented circular-order signings; the vector u=B sigma/n strictly exposes each and gives uniqueness. Central symmetry gives the unique origin circumcenter and antipodal diametral pairs. For any nonzero tetrahedron defect t, parity forces |t_T|>=2 and 5-vertex boundary-of-boundary incidence forces at least n-3 distinct nonzero entries, hence squared gap >=n-3. Flipping one triangle in an outer signing produces exactly n-3 defect entries of size 2, and u'=u-(sigma_j/2)Be_j strictly exposes the new signing; so sharp second shell is real vertex. An independent Gray-code exhaustive enumeration of all 1,049,618 signings across n=3..6 reproduced (n,R^2,contacts,next)=(3,3/4,2,none),(4,4,6,3),(5,25/2,24,21/2),(6,30,120,27). These finite tests are corroboration; the chain/cocycle proof covers all n.
